hostHint: The adapter finds the host by itself as long as it sits in the same network segment as the speakers. SSDP is not forwarded between segments - in that case enter the addresses here.
hostAddressHelp: Leave empty for automatic discovery. The list comes from a live scan of the network; an address can also be entered by hand.
bindAddressHelp: Only needed when the machine has several network cards. Pick the card that sits in the speakers' segment - it also carries the callback channel for device events.
helpText: The host is the device running the system management, recognisable by the open port 47365. While it is switched off the whole system reports nothing - Spotify Connect stops listing the speakers as well. If the adapter sits in a different network segment, the devices must also be able to reach it back, otherwise they report no changes.
